description: If you report project schedules in Power BI, you need more than a basic timeline. ProGantt helps you turn task data into executive-ready project schedule reports with dependencies, baselines, critical path analysis, milestones, swimlanes, and progress tracking. Use ProGantt to improve schedule reporting accuracy, spot delivery risk earlier, and keep stakeholders aligned without leaving Power BI. For example, you can show which tasks drive the finish date, compare the current plan against approved baselines, and group work by team, phase, or workstream. Unlike simple Gantt visuals or spreadsheet-style timeline workarounds, ProGantt is built for enterprise project reporting: it supports all four dependency types with lag or lead, automatic critical path calculation, dual baseline comparison, scalable hierarchy, flexible grid columns, and native Power BI cross-filtering. Key Features Dependency mapping - Finish-to-Start, Start-to-Start, Finish-to-Finish, and Start-to-Finish relationships help you explain why work must happen in sequence. Critical path analysis - highlights the tasks and links that drive the project finish date, so leaders can focus on schedule risk. Baseline comparison - compare planned vs. current dates to make schedule slippage visible in status meetings. Hierarchy and swimlanes - organize large programs by phase, team, workstream, or portfolio category.…
